repos.name: news-aggregator
repos.purpose: Monorepo for the Windows-local Go host, Vue PWA, shared contracts, persistence, ingestion/ranking engine, packaging, and verification.
contains: Shared-first ownership: api/openapi.yaml, internal/domain/**, db/migrations/**, test/fixtures/**
Backend-lane ownership: cmd/news-aggregator/**, internal/application/**, internal/adapters/**, internal/httpapi/**, internal/platform/**
Frontend-lane ownership: web/src/**, web/public/**, web/tests/**, web package and build configuration
Generated boundary: web/src/api/generated/** is produced only from api/openapi.yaml and is not hand-edited
Integration ownership: tests/integration/**, tests/e2e/**, packaging/windows/**, CI workflow files
Planning ownership: assembly/generated/project_spec.json, assembly/generated/repo_plan.json, assembly/generated/agent_prompts.json, assembly/generated/slots_db.json, assembly/planning_runs/**
excludes: Cloud deployment, remote database, authentication, accounts, or synchronization
Task backlog and task-batch files during the planning phase
Secrets, API keys, downloaded article corpora, local SQLite databases, and generated runtime caches
